requestedText: Register the existing Weekly Radar read models and add a deterministic complete archival Markdown renderer that preserves supplied facts and order.

evidence: The renderer uses only borrowed Rust read-model references and does not load modules, files, network resources, or runtime providers dynamically.
No external consumer, publisher, scheduler, persistence adapter, or provider is added; the public interface is exercised only by the declared module-local and integration tests.
The renderer contains no monitoring, telemetry, delivery, persistence, scheduling, or runtime integration.
The Contract declares additive module registration, interface rendering, focused tests, docs, and governed evidence; it excludes shared coverage policy and global architecture tests.
The approved scheme 1 adds a renderer and registration paths without deleting, renaming, or migrating an existing public target.
